title: Apply to reserve an association name
summary: Learn how to apply to reserve a proposed name for an association.
intro:
You can reserve a proposed name for:

Reserving a proposed name is optional.

Before you start your application, check whether the name you have chosen has already been registered.
who_can_apply: A person who is authorised by the association committee can apply to reserve a name.
what_you_need: 3 proposed names for your association in order of preference
The PDF form: 'Application for reservation of name (Form A1)'

how_to_steps.text: Complete the form and submit it with your payment either:

more_info.text: If approved, the name will be reserved for 3 months and expire if the association does not incorporate in that time.
The period of 3 months for name reservation cannot be extended.

It’s your responsibility to check whether a name is restricted in a way that may prevent the use of it, such as it closely resembles an existing incorporated association name, or is the same as a registered business or company name.
